Three ways to work together

A new home for your work

A small editorial site, journal, or portfolio built around your actual content. We start with the structure, then work through type, images, and the details that make publishing feel straightforward.

Includes page planning, a block theme, and an editor walkthrough.

A thoughtful refresh

Keep the parts of your existing site that work. Refine the reading experience, simplify the navigation, and give the pages a consistent visual language without starting over.

Includes a content audit, layout refinements, and mobile checks.

Help with the next chapter

A focused session to work through an awkward page, a new section, or a publishing workflow. A useful option when you know what you want to do but need a second pair of eyes.

Includes a working session and a short set of practical next steps.

A straightforward process

  1. Understand the work. We look at your content, audience, and what the site needs to make possible.
  2. Build with real material. A long article, a short announcement, and a real image tell us more than an empty wireframe.
  3. Make it yours. We check small screens, keyboard use, and the editor before handing over the keys.

A few practical questions

Can I edit the pages myself?

Yes. These layouts use native WordPress blocks. Text, images, menus, and most visual defaults can be changed in the editor without writing code.

Do I need all my content ready?

Not everything, but a representative article and a rough page outline help us make better decisions. We can work through the rest together.

Is this a real service offer?

This is an illustrative services page for the Suppeth demo. Alex and the services are fictional; no booking or payment is available.
